column1: # json-s1-blocks.rewrites.tsv -- generated by
# probes/install/ir/capture-s1-blocks.sh; do not edit.
# Every place the normalisation *rewrote* text of the clang emission of
# kernel/json/s1_blocks.c instead of removing it, with the reason the rewrite is
# sound.  Two kinds:
#   rename      a register renamed.  The body's seven parameters carry the ABI's
#               own names (%b, %n, %ent, %xp, %nxp, %xcarry, %arm), so this
#               capture applies none; the mechanism is kept so a divergence is
#               recorded rather than silently absorbed.  Innocence is shown, not
#               asserted: the capture emits the source with and without
#               -fno-discard-value-names and requires the two texts to be
#               identical once every register name is replaced by one
#               placeholder.
#   substitute  a token replaced by a defined one.  `poison`, class 6 of the
#               normalisation's classes; the lane it occupies is read by no
#               observable (`pclmulqdq` at immediate 0 uses lane 0 and the
#               `extractelement ... 0` that follows reads lane 0).
# A rewrite with no row here stops the capture: the alignment refuses any token
# the body adds that is not one of the substitutions declared here, and this
# file must account for every substitution it made.  `line` is the line of the
# emission, as in the strip inventory.
